text:
Solder is an alloy of lead and tin. It is used for joining pieces of metal.
heated solder
molten solder
metal
Which statement about solder is correct?
A
It can be represented by a chemical formula.
B
It contains a mixture of lead and tin.
C
It contains lead and tin chemically combined.
D
It has a higher melting point than lead or tin.

options.label: A
options.text: It can be represented by a chemical formula.

options.label: B
options.text: It contains a mixture of lead and tin.

options.label: C
options.text: It contains lead and tin chemically combined.

options.label: D
options.text: It has a higher melting point than lead or tin.
